subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Peace education in schools primarily aims to develop in students:

options.option_text: Skills for non-violent conflict resolution, tolerance, and respect for diversity
Rote memorisation of historical wars only

explanation: Peace education aims to build attitudes and skills for non-violent conflict resolution, empathy, tolerance, and respect for diversity — helping students become constructive, peaceful members of society.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch — Contemporary Educational Concerns
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Population education in the school curriculum primarily helps students understand:

options.option_text: The relationship between population growth, resources, and quality of life
Only the exact current population count of India
Advanced statistical formulae unrelated to real life

explanation: Population education helps students understand how population dynamics relate to resources, environment, health, and development — building informed, responsible future citizens rather than just teaching census numbers.

stem: Education that helps students see themselves as members of a broader world community, developing awareness of global issues like climate change and human rights alongside respect for local identity, is called:
explanation: Global citizenship education fosters awareness of global interconnectedness and shared responsibility (climate, human rights, peace) while still respecting local and national identity.
